title: Special Topics in Public Policy; Cracking the Code: AI, Race, Gender & Policy Innovation for a 21st Century World
description: Explores the interplay between race, gender, science, technology, and public policy. In an era where science and technologies increasingly impact various aspects of society, it is crucial to understand how these fields can reinforce or mitigate existing disparities related to race and gender. Drawing from diverse disciplines that include politics,science,and ethics, students will explore how these interconnected fields are shaped by our society, institutions, and policymaking processes. Through critical examination, students will analyze ethical, social, and policy dimensions of science and technological development.
